confidenceLegend.OBSERVED: string/attribute read directly in the served bundle
confidenceLegend.INFERRED: selector follows from an observed route/role/attribute but was not seen in a hydrated logged-in DOM
confidenceLegend.LEGACY_UNVERIFIED: classic responsive-web data-testid; ABSENT from the current x-web bundle, kept only as a fallback

_meta.warning: The classic data-testid attributes (tweetTextarea_0, tweetButton, addButton, fileInput, ...) do NOT occur anywhere in the currently served x-web bundle. Prefer the primary selectors; use legacy ones only if the account is served the old responsive-web client.
_meta.selectorSyntax: Playwright selector strings: CSS by default, with :has-text()/:text-is() used only where visible text is the sole discriminator. Parameterised selectors use <screen_name> or .nth(n) notes.
